youtube.title: VTuber Sunhee
youtube.description:
Sunhee is a second year college student with a major case of *chuunibyou. Currently the President of the Anime Club, Sunhee believes she will one day become Supreme leader of the WORLD. Through her eccentric personality she recruits those she deems worthy to join the Anime Club (doesn't this sound like a cult?). 

*(Chuunibyou[1] (中二病; Chūnibyō) is a derogative colloquial term in the Japanese language used to describe a person who manifests delusional behavior, particularly thinking that one has special powers that no other person has.)
